metadata.description: Shared Claude skills: code and infrastructure review standards, project workflow, and Claude Code plugins (UI mods, COG reporting).

plugins.name: code-standards
plugins.description: Structured review skills for Java/Spring Boot code and infrastructure (Kubernetes, Docker, IaC, CI/CD).

plugins.name: project-workflow
plugins.description: Consistent project setup and tracking: org-standards repo checks, ticket start/finish flow, and well-structured Jira issues.

plugins.name: context-usage
plugins.description: Claude Code only: shows context window usage as a colour-coded horizontal stacked bar above the prompt. Toggle with /context-usage [on|off].

plugins.name: cog-reporting
plugins.description: Claude Code only: reporting for COG (Claude Observability GUI). Telemetry module records per-request, per-tool, per-turn and per-subagent data as JSONL for COG to ingest; /cog-telemetry shows what has been collected.
